segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned above the blue bowl, preparing to interact with it.
The robot arm descends and grasps the blue bowl, lifting it slightly.
The robot arm moves the blue bowl towards the small crate, positioning it for pouring.
The robot arm tilts the blue bowl, pouring half of its contents into the small crate.
The robot arm lifts the blue bowl away from the crate, completing the pour.
The robot arm moves back to its initial position, finishing the task.
